description: End-to-end customer support workflow for managing mobile device swap requests in a telco-as-a-service (TaaS) CAMARA environment, including eligibility checks, shipping logistics, activation, and exception handling.

ticket_id.description: Support ticket identifier for the device swap case

customer_id.description: Unique customer identifier in the telco system

swap_request_id.description: Identifier for a specific device swap request

device_id.description: Identifier of a physical device (IMEI or inventory ID)

shipping_order_id.description: Identifier of an outbound or return shipping order

activation_id.description: Identifier of a device/SIM activation transaction

log_entry_id.description: Identifier of an audit/log entry related to the swap

functions.name: create_device_swap_ticket
functions.description: Create a new support ticket to initiate a device swap flow for a customer.

subscription_id.description: Subscription/line for which the swap is requested

issue_summary.description: Short description of why a device swap is requested

issue_details.description: Full narrative describing the device issue and context

reported_device.description: Details of the device being replaced

purchase_date.description: Original purchase date of the device

damage_description.description: If damaged, description of the damage

channel.description: Channel where the request was created

attachments.description: Optional attachments such as photos of damage or receipts

metadata.description: Custom metadata for routing and reporting

functions.returns: New ticket_id, initial ticket status, and a summary of captured details.

functions.name: evaluate_device_swap_eligibility
functions.description: Evaluate whether the customer and subscription are eligible for a device swap and under what conditions.

evaluation_context.description: Additional input to steer eligibility logic

is_insurance_claim.description: Whether this swap is processed under an insurance policy

include_rule_trace.description: If true, return details of which eligibility rules were applied

functions.returns: Eligibility decision (eligible, conditionally_eligible, ineligible), applied conditions (fees, required documents), and optional rule trace.

functions.name: propose_swap_options
functions.description: Generate and present eligible device swap options based on inventory, customer profile, and eligibility outcome.

eligibility_result.description: Eligibility result or reference returned from evaluate_device_swap_eligibility

max_subsidy_amount.description: Maximum subsidy in the customer's currency

required_copay.description: Minimum copayment required from customer, if any

preference_filters.description: Customer preferences to filter proposed devices

include_inventory_details.description: If true, return stock location and ETA for each option

functions.returns: List of proposed swap options including device models, pricing, constraints, and inventory availability.

functions.name: create_device_swap_request
functions.description: Create a formal device swap request from a ticket and selected device option, including associated financial terms.

ticket_id.description: Source support ticket for the request

device_sku.description: SKU or catalog code of replacement device

inventory_location_id.description: Primary inventory location to fulfill from

commercial_terms.description: Financial conditions agreed with the customer

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g., EUR, USD

device_price.description: Price of the replacement device before discounts

fees.description: Additional fees applied to the swap

swap_mode.description: How the swap will be operationally processed

requested_timeline.description: Customer's preferred timeline for the swap

functions.returns: Created swap_request_id, initial status (e.g., drafted, pending_customer_confirmation), and financial summary.

functions.name: get_device_swap_request
functions.description: Retrieve full details of an existing device swap request.

swap_request_id.description: Identifier of the swap request to retrieve

include.description: Additional related resources to include in response

functions.returns: Complete swap request details including status, linked ticket, shipping and activation details if available.

functions.name: update_device_swap_request
functions.description: Update mutable properties of an existing device swap request before it is finalized.

updates.description: Fields that can be updated prior to fulfillment

selected_option.description: Updated device option details, if changing device

reason.description: Agent- or system-provided reason for update

functions.returns: Updated swap request details and new status where applicable.

functions.name: confirm_device_swap_request
functions.description: Confirm a device swap request after customer consent and lock it for fulfillment.

customer_acceptance.description: Evidence and meta-data of customer acceptance

accepted_terms_version.description: Version of terms and conditions accepted

ip_address.description: IP address at the time of digital confirmation

recording_reference.description: If via phone, call recording reference

initial_payment_status.description: Result of any upfront payment attempt for copay/fees

functions.returns: Finalized swap request with status updated to confirmed or payment_pending, plus payment and confirmation summaries.

functions.name: initiate_swap_logistics
functions.description: Trigger logistics for the device swap, including outbound shipment of the new device and optionally a return kit for the old device.

swap_request_id.description: Swap request for which to start logistics

logistics_plan.description: Details of how logistics should be executed

outbound.description: Configuration for shipping the replacement device

return_kit.description: Configuration for returning the old device, if required

functions.returns: Created shipping_order_id(s) for outbound and return legs, with initial tracking details and logistics status.

functions.name: track_swap_logistics_status
functions.description: Get real-time status updates of logistics related to a device swap, including outbound and return shipments.

swap_request_id.description: Swap request whose logistics are being tracked

shipping_order_id.description: Specific shipping order to track, if known

include_events.description: Whether to include detailed event timeline from carrier

functions.returns: Current logistics status per shipping_order_id, estimated delivery/return dates, and optional event history.

functions.name: activate_swapped_device
functions.description: Activate the new device (and SIM/eSIM if applicable) and associate it with the customer's subscription as part of the swap.

swap_request_id.description: Swap request for which the new device is being activated

subscription_id.description: Subscription to bind the new device to

new_device.description: Technical details of the new device

device_id.description: Identifier of the device (IMEI or inventory ID)

iccid.description: Identifier of physical SIM card, if applicable

scheduled_time.description: When to activate if activation_mode is scheduled

deactivate_old_device.description: Whether to deactivate the old device immediately

functions.returns: Activation_id, new network provisioning status, and old device deactivation result.

functions.name: handle_swap_exception
functions.description: Capture and manage exceptions in the device swap process, such as failed delivery, activation failures, or customer no-show.

ticket_id.description: Related support ticket for the exception

carrier_event_payload.description: Raw carrier or partner payload if relevant

proposed_resolution.description: How the system or agent proposes to resolve the exception

functions.returns: Recorded exception case, linked to the swap and ticket, with updated swap status and any follow-up actions created.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_device_swap
functions.description: Execute a controlled retry or rollback of a device swap in response to failures or customer changes.

swap_request_id.description: Swap request to retry or rollback

operation.description: Whether to retry a failed step or rollback swap operations

target_stage.description: Stage at which to retry or rollback

rollback_options.description: Options for rollback behavior; optional for retry

keep_new_device_active.description: If true, maintain new device active even if rolling back billing/logistics

revert_to_old_device.description: If true, attempt to reactivate the old device and SIM

retry_context.description: Optional override parameters when retrying specific steps

new_logistics_plan.description: Alternative logistics plan if retrying logistics

reason.description: Business justification for retry or rollback

functions.returns: Result of retry or rollback operation, including updated swap_request status and any new logistics/activation references.

functions.name: cancel_device_swap
functions.description: Cancel an in-progress device swap, optionally triggering reverse logistics and billing adjustments.

ticket_id.description: Related ticket to update with cancellation status

cancellation_details.description: Additional details for audit and downstream processing

reverse_logistics.description: How to handle devices if swap is already partially fulfilled

billing_adjustment.description: How to deal with any charges already applied

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation, final swap_request and ticket statuses, and any created reverse logistics or refund actions.

functions.name: search_device_swap_requests
functions.description: Faceted search across device swap requests with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of device swap request summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_device_swap_requests
functions.description: Create multiple device swap requests in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created device swap request ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_device_swap_requests
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many device swap requests with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each device swap request, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_device_swap_requests
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many device swap requests in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each device swap request, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_device_swap_requests
functions.description: Export device swap request datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_device_swap_requests
functions.description: Bulk-import device swap request records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated device swap requests.

functions.name: subscribe_to_device_swap_request_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive device swap request lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the device swap request.

functions.name: get_device_swap_request_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a device swap request, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the device swap request, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_device_swap_request_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for device swap requests using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the device swap request action.

functions.name: simulate_device_swap_request_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a device swap request without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the device swap request, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_device_swap_request_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a device swap request change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the device swap request under change.

functions.name: decide_device_swap_request_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending device swap request approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the device swap request.

functions.name: add_device_swap_request_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a device swap request for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the device swap request.

functions.name: upload_device_swap_request_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a device swap request with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the device swap request.

functions.name: create_device_swap_request_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a device swap request (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the device swap request version captured.

functions.name: restore_device_swap_request_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a device swap request from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the device swap request.

functions.name: get_device_swap_request_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for device swap requests over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the device swap request domain context.

functions.name: get_device_swap_request_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for device swap requests combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the device swap request context.

functions.name: create_device_swap_request_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to device swap requests with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current device swap requests.

functions.name: evaluate_device_swap_request_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a device swap request in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the device swap request.

functions.name: get_device_swap_request_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a device swap request including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the device swap request, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_device_swap_request_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a device swap request and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the device swap request.

functions.name: assign_device_swap_request_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a device swap request with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the device swap request with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_device_swap_requests
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more device swap requests, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each device swap request.

functions.name: compare_device_swap_request_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a device swap request with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the device swap request, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_device_swap_request_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to device swap request operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of device swap request operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_device_swap_request_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a device swap request and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the device swap request, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_device_swap_request
functions.description: Clone a device swap request into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned device swap request record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_device_swap_request_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted device swap request report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the device swap request window covered.

functions.name: escalate_device_swap_request
functions.description: Escalate a device swap request to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the device swap request.
